Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the call today — really appreciate the context on Acme's search and customer support use cases. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

1) Recap (what I heard)
- Primary goal: improve developer support throughput and reduce time-to-resolution for high-priority incidents using LLM-augmented summarization and reranking.
- Primary constraints: must run in VPC (data residency), SOC 2 evidence required, and predictable latency for interactive support workflows.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average handle time (AHT) for Tier 2 tickets during pilot.

2) Next steps
- Technical deep dive / demo w/ Rishi (our solutions architect) to validate latency and deployment model (30–45 mins).
- Exec alignment: quick intro between your VP of Engineering / CTO and our Head of Product to unblock procurement and scope.
- I'll share a short mutual action plan and a product deck.

Proposed dates for the technical deep dive: Wed 5/1 between 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 5/2 14:00–16:00 PT. If those don't work, send a few times that do.

I've attached: redwood-product-deck.pdf (2 slides on architecture + performance) and a draft mutual-action-plan.xlsx with proposed milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to the next call.

Best,
